answer_1.quote: We experiment using the Multidialect Dataset of Dialogues (MD3) ... The language model is used to predict the intent of the dialogue using a brief description of the game and the transcript truncated right before the correct guess.
answer_1.outputs: The models generate responses to prompts in dialogue, question answering, and opinion prediction tasks, which are then evaluated for intent prediction, answer correctness, and opinion alignment.

answer_2.quote: We assess generated answers using CFM scores , a trained classifier over F1 scores and similar text features, which has been shown to correlate well with expert judgments.

answer_3.quote: We probe the Starling 7B Reward Model  and explore how its preferences vary on several counterfactual country opinion-based questions rather than multiple-choice questions.
